purpose: The P31 canon v2 component manifest — the machine-readable contract an agent reads to COMPOSE a face without porting JSX. Consume intent, never raw values. Appearance comes from var(--p31-*) tokens; the shell owns geometry only. This is the reconciled successor of the legacy portals/shell/docs/components.manifest.json (v1.0.0), which listed 11 components, had no Card entry, and no forbidden list.

layer_wiring.declare: import '@p31ca/canon/css/layers.css' FIRST — before tokens and any stylesheet that emits layered rules (the first @layer order declaration wins).
layer_wiring.components: @p31ca/design-core/css/canon-v2.css — emits @layer canon.layout and @layer canon.components. Import via '@p31ca/design-core/css/index.css' (aggregate) or the standalone path.
layer_wiring.shell: Portal shell-only chrome goes in @layer shell. Canon owns appearance; the shell may set geometry only (Seven Laws, law 1).
layer_wiring.face: RESERVED. Faces ship NO CSS. Any stylesheet landing in @layer face is a visible violation.
layer_wiring.unlayered: Unlayered CSS beats every layer — the canon-lint gate fails unlayered imports. The only sanctioned unlayered overrides are the runtime-conditional blocks in tokens.css (data-spoons / data-dark-mode / data-theme / data-portal).

page_modes.flow: Document scroll. Width-capped column (--p31-page-max), page owns its rhythm. NO global html/body height-100% flex shell on flow routes.
page_modes.fill: Viewport app. Fills its container; the [data-p31-grow] child is the one scrolling region. A fill page inside [data-p31="shell"] pins the shell to 100dvh.
page_modes.panel-scroll: Document page with ONE internal scrolling panel (the Sandbox split pattern).
page_modes.fit: Single-screen-fit — alias of fill for now.
page_modes.rule: The fill/flow conflation was the root cause of the 560px select bug. One mode per page; never nest a fill page inside a flow page.

composition_rules: Compose from these components. Never port styled JSX from another app.
The shell owns geometry (position/size/flow). Canon owns appearance (color/surface/radius/shadow/type).
Theming is a value swap at the semantic tier — never fork a component per theme.
New canon CSS is attribute-scoped: [data-p31="x"] selectors only. No bare class names (that was the .surface-panel collision).
Every value routes through a var(--p31-*) token or a catalog component. Hex literals outside tokens are forbidden.
Raw <select>/<input>/<textarea> outside canon controls are forbidden — use Select/Input/Textarea/Field.
If a variant is missing, extend the canon (design-core), never fork in the shell.
Patterns (ListingShell, DetailShell, Wizard) ship WITH canon — a component library is not a design system.

canon_v2.name: Shell
canon_v2.purpose: App frame: top / (sidebar) / main grid; skip link; fill-page viewport pinning.

canon_v2.name: Page
canon_v2.purpose: The four page modes: flow / fill / panel-scroll / fit.

canon_v2.name: PageHeaderV2
canon_v2.purpose: Page title / subtitle / actions (canon v2 successor of the legacy PageHeader).

canon_v2.name: Stack
canon_v2.purpose: One-axis flex: dir / gap / align / justify.

canon_v2.name: Grid
canon_v2.purpose: Auto-fill card grid; data-min picks the floor (15/17.5/22.5rem).

canon_v2.name: Split
canon_v2.purpose: Two panes + draggable handle; pointer resize + keyboard; collapses under 47.99rem.

canon_v2.name: Field
canon_v2.purpose: Label / control / hint / error grid; data-width="form" cap.

canon_v2.name: Input
canon_v2.purpose: Text input on the control contract (44px height, max 64px, focus ring).

canon_v2.name: Textarea
canon_v2.purpose: Multiline control; min-height 2x control height; resize vertical only.

canon_v2.name: Select
canon_v2.purpose: Native select on the control contract.

canon_v2.name: Tabs
canon_v2.purpose: Roving-tabindex tablist.

canon_v2.name: Menu
canon_v2.purpose: Vertical action list (role=menu).

canon_v2.name: Dialog
canon_v2.purpose: Modal: scrim, Escape closes, focus lands on the panel.

canon_v2.name: Sheet
canon_v2.purpose: Side panel (start/end).

canon_v2.name: EmptyState
canon_v2.purpose: Dashed-surface empty state with optional action.

canon_v2.name: ErrorState
canon_v2.purpose: Solid error-border state; role=alert.

canon_v2.name: Skeleton
canon_v2.purpose: Shimmer loading placeholder (bars + block shape).

canon_v2.name: ListingShell
canon_v2.purpose: Pattern — search/filter row + card grid + empty state (Discover).

canon_v2.name: DetailShell
canon_v2.purpose: Pattern — summary column + focus region + action row (Server).

canon_v2.name: Wizard
canon_v2.purpose: Pattern — Step N of M + one question group per step + back/next (Publish).

reconciled.name: Card
reconciled.purpose: First-class surface card (title/description/padding/interactive). Referenced by the surface spec; missing from the legacy manifest. Ships in @p31ca/design-core/compositions at tier core since v2.2.0.

reconciled.name: PageHeader
reconciled.purpose: Legacy page header (`.page-header-route`, eyebrow/lede). Deprecated at the portal port; PageHeaderV2 is the canon v2 contract.

forbidden.message: Raw <select> outside canon. Use <Select> from canon.
Raw <input> outside canon. Use <Input> or <Field> from canon.
Raw <textarea> outside canon. Use <Textarea> or <Field> from canon.
Legacy class name. Use canon primitives (the attribute-scoped [data-p31=...] contract).
Unlayered CSS defeats the cascade contract. Import via layers.css and stay inside the declared layers.

forbidden.pattern: new canon CSS must not declare bare class selectors
forbidden.message: Global/bare class names collide across faces (the .surface-panel bug). New canon styles are [data-p31=...] attribute-scoped only.
Hex literal outside tokens. Every visual value routes through a var(--p31-*) token.
